# Request to amend a client record

Dear Records Officer,

We act for ⟦PERSON|Elspeth Quenby⟧, who is known within the workshop as ⟦PERSON|Effie⟧. Our client asks that future notices use the full name in the signed instruction rather than the abbreviated entry carried over from an earlier enquiry. The workshop nickname remains useful when identifying the archived correspondence.

The instruction contains this personal detail: **DOB:** ⟦DATE|23 September 1991⟧. That value is provided solely to distinguish our client's record from another entry. It is not a proposed commencement date for the revised agreement. The agreement itself was signed on 12 August 2026 and remains in force.

Please preserve the existing correspondence and add a dated correction note. Replacing the old entry without retaining the reason for the change would make it difficult to explain why earlier notices used a different form. We request written confirmation after the correction is complete.

Our client has authorised a reply to ⟦EMAIL|effie.instructions@reed-cairn.invalid⟧. Please do not include a copy of the identity document unless a specific discrepancy requires it. The authority to correct the record does not extend to accepting a new payment schedule.

Yours faithfully,

⟦PERSON|Toren Ilvek⟧

For ⟦ORG|Reed Cairn Advice Ltd⟧, records team
